regenerate: bun install && bun run build && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.quality.config.ts tests/quality/photos-parity.contract.test.ts  # the oracle for contracts/tools/export-photos-parity.ts; then bun run format && git diff --exit-code contracts/apps/photos
why: The generator (contracts/tools/export-photos-parity.ts) is committed and unrun: producing queries.json needs `bun run build` and the v0 handler graph, and the machine the lane ran on had 2.6 GB of disk left (df -h /home/user). No fixture here was typed by hand, and none was generated by the port: what is committed is the sample roll (copied byte for byte from packages/blueprints/apps/photos/sample) and this declaration. crates/apps/photos/tests/parity.rs asserts this file says `pending-regeneration`, so a green suite cannot be read as parity.
design_why: The outputs carry partyHueValue / identityInitials / figureTone from packages/design, which has no Rust home until design/ lands (D-1020-D3-9). Comparing the arithmetic without them would mean editing a generated fixture.
orderWhy: Those three statements order by core_party.display_name, which SQLite compares under BINARY collation and v0 renders under localeCompare. For ASCII names the two agree; for a non-ASCII roster they do not, so the case is compared as a SET (D-1020-D3-6).
